## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a cautionary exemplar to name the criterion the passage ACTUALLY evidences — the redirect from the axis it superficially resembles.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it on positive or negative exemplars (it is the cautionary redirect) and avoid forcing a single target — a boundary case may touch several axes, so keep it non-functional.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:exemplarRedirect`](gmeow-exemplarRedirect.md) from a cautionary [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md) to the [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md) it really evidences; pair it with [`gmeow:exemplarPolarity`](gmeow-exemplarPolarity.md) [`gmeow:polarityCautionary`](../individuals/gmeow-polarityCautionary.md).
